# Risk-based review coverage

Select rows supported by the detected stack and review scope. Read the named generated instructions when present; language and framework modules refine every applicable row.

| Area | What to trace | Primary generated instructions |
|---|---|---|
| Authentication and identity | Login, password/recovery, MFA, sessions, JWT validation and key selection, OAuth/OIDC/SAML flows, service identity | `authentication`, `cryptography`, framework modules |
| Authorization and business logic | Object/tenant/role decisions, mass assignment, authoritative prices/roles/states, workflow skipping, retries, idempotency, races and TOCTOU | `authorization-business-logic`, `api`, framework modules |
| APIs | REST/GraphQL/WebSocket/protobuf entry points, BOLA/BFLA, schema exposure, batching/complexity, content types and message authorization | `api`, `authentication`, `authorization-business-logic` |
| Injection | SQL/NoSQL, command, code, template, expression, LDAP/XML and spreadsheet formula interpreters | `core`, `data-database`, language/framework modules |
| Server-side processing | SSRF and redirects, path traversal, native deserialization, XML entities, host/proxy trust, parser disagreement and resource bounds | `server-side`, `file-handling`, `reverse-proxy` |
| Browser and frontend | Reflected/stored/DOM XSS, unsafe HTML/URL sinks, CSRF, CORS, postMessage, prototype pollution, client-side trust and storage | `browser-web`, JavaScript and frontend modules |
| Files and archives | Upload identity/content, public retrieval, archive extraction, canonical paths, race windows, parser isolation and size/depth limits | `file-handling`, `server-side` |
| Data and database | Bound queries, tenant scoping, least privilege, sensitive fields, exports, backup/replica exposure and transactional integrity | `data-database`, `logging-privacy`, `cryptography` |
| Secrets and configuration | Committed credentials, client bundles, fixtures, logs, deployment files, separation and rotation paths; mask all evidence | `secrets-configuration`, `ci-cd`, infrastructure modules |
| Cryptography and transport | Password KDFs, randomness, key/nonce lifecycle, authenticated encryption, signature verification, TLS validation and trust stores | `cryptography`, language/framework modules |
| Logging, privacy and errors | Secret/PII leakage, log injection, audit coverage, stack traces, error or enumeration oracles, cache handling and retention | `logging-privacy`, `browser-web`, `authentication` |
| Dependencies and supply chain | Lockfile integrity, provenance, lifecycle scripts, typosquats, malicious/obfuscated behavior, artifact/action/image pinning and build provenance | `dependencies`, `ci-cd`, `containers` |
| CI/CD | Untrusted interpolation, pull-request trust, token permissions, OIDC claims, mutable actions, artifact boundaries and protected environments | `ci-cd`, `secrets-configuration` |
| Cloud, IaC, containers and edge | Public exposure, IAM/RBAC, network policy, storage, metadata access, workload identity, container privilege, K8s admission, proxy/cache/firewall scope | `iac-cloud`, `containers`, `kubernetes`, `reverse-proxy` |
| Events, queues, integrations and webhooks | Producer identity, message schema, replay, ordering, duplicate effects, tenant context, webhook signatures and OAuth scopes | `event-messaging`, `saas-webhooks`, `api` |
| AI/ML systems | Prompt/data trust, RAG tenant isolation and poisoning, output sinks, tool authorization, excessive agency, model loading/supply chain, cost/privacy limits | `ai-ml`, `authorization-business-logic`, `dependencies` |
| Mobile applications | Local storage, exported components/deep links, WebViews, platform permissions, certificate validation, backend authorization | `mobile`, `api`, `authentication` |
| Smart contracts | Privileged/upgrade paths, reentrancy and call ordering, unchecked calls, oracle/bridge assumptions, signatures, arithmetic and denial of service | `solidity` |
| Payment and regulated data | Account-data boundaries, retention/masking, key separation, integrity, auditability, dependency/change controls and deployment modes | `payment-card`, `cryptography`, `logging-privacy` |
| Language/framework hazards | Dangerous APIs, unsafe escape hatches, middleware/filter ordering, serialization, templating and runtime-specific memory/concurrency behavior | every detected language/framework module |

## Scenario families distilled from Argus

The rows above incorporate the defensive lessons from Argus scenario families: JWT key/algorithm confusion; OAuth redirect/state/PKCE and modern identity tenancy; GraphQL federation, complexity and object authorization; WebSocket handshake/message authorization; DOM sinks, postMessage and prototype pollution; SQL/NoSQL/code injection variants; deserialization, uploads, traversal, SSRF, host trust and request parsing; workflow, cache and race failures; cloud IAM/RBAC/workload identity; LLM/RAG/tool confused-deputy paths; Solidity governance/DeFi assumptions; and PCI software lifecycle controls.

Exploit payloads, credential attacks, phishing, persistence, scanner commands, live-service probing, lateral movement, cloud abuse, container escape procedures, and PoC automation are intentionally not included.
